label: KILLS_2: the intervention reaches the one's harm by a path avoiding redirection
definition: KillsByNewThreat c: the intervention reaches the one's harm by a causal path that never passes through the redirection of the threat already facing the five, so the agent introduces a new threat to the one. This is a stipulated technical relation, not ordinary killing: in ordinary use, and in the usual description of the bystander case, diverting the trolley kills the one (KILLS_1).
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
